about: Train e95, the 2b bind audit: since e95 unit 2b the saved document keeps every arm of a switch on a member's input.string, so every member-facing gate that reads it binds at the instance's settings (the declared defaults when there is no instance) and never refuses a knob script on an arm the member did not pick. Each binding site, un-bound once, must turn its rail red (the rails' CONTROLS pin that a PICKED arm still refuses by name).

mutants.mutant: evaluability decides every lane on the SAVED document (an unpicked arm's event field refuses the header value and the alert mirror)
the header custom stat reads the SAVED document's other-symbol stamp (every arm's)
mutants.from: const def = isObj(savedDef) ? boundAtInputs(savedDef, inputs || {}) : savedDef

mutants.mutant: the alert admission asks its gates of the SAVED tree (an unpicked arm's event field refuses every setting)
an instance's picked arm is never re-asked (it arms and stays silent)
the trigger policy types the plot off the SAVED tree (an unpicked arm's scalar makes it a scalar)
the scan door gates the SAVED scan tree (an unpicked arm's event field is a benchmark refusal)
the sweep evaluates the SAVED scan tree, not the one the door admitted
the financial fetch reads the SAVED document (an unpicked arm's financial read is fetched for)
the lower-timeframe fetch reads the SAVED document's stamp (an unpicked arm's lower timeframe is fetched for)
mutants.from: const def = saved ? boundAtInputs(saved, inst.inputs) : null

mutants.mutant: the alert column's history check reads the unbound tree (an unpicked arm's longer lookback withholds every bar)
